Plot Boxplot of Peak Intensities by Metadata

Source: R/utils_bulk.R
bulk_utils_peaks_boxplot.Rd

Plots a boxplot of peak intensities for each sample, grouped by a metadata column.

Usage

bulk_utils_peaks_boxplot(
  sub.intensity.matrix,
  metadata,
  log.transformation = TRUE,
  metadata.column = 2
)

Arguments

sub.intensity.matrix

Numeric matrix or data frame of intensities (features × samples).

metadata

Data frame of sample metadata.

log.transformation

Logical; whether to log2-transform intensities (default: TRUE).

metadata.column

Integer index of metadata column to use for grouping (default: 2).

Value

List with elements: 'plot' (ggplot object) and 'table' (data frame used for plotting).
